body: Collier said “time will tell” if the tariffs and other rules for large loads are effective, and the needs of each territory are different. But some early evidence appears to show that
the tariffs can weed out speculative requests from the large load pipeline.
AEP Ohio cut its large load forecast by more than 50%, from 30 GW to 13 GW,
after regulators approved a new large load tariff last year, though manufacturers in the state say data center demand is still inflated.
